messages.content: The host has confirmed the Thursday inspection for 9:00 a.m. It should be finished by noon, so I need to stay Wednesday night and fly home Thursday. Please compare the Sunday outbound and Thursday afternoon options with realistic airport travel time.

I’ll use Sunday, January 11 and Thursday, January 15. The Sunday Delta nonstop at 5:35 p.m. still arrives at MSY at 6:10 p.m. Allowing about 25 minutes to deplane and collect a checked bag, plus 25 to 40 minutes by car to the Cambria, you should reach the hotel around 7:00 to 7:20 p.m., leaving a comfortable evening before the 8:00 a.m. Monday report time.

For Thursday, the 3:55 p.m. Delta nonstop is workable but tight if the inspection runs to noon: leaving the museum at 12:15 would likely put you at MSY between 12:45 and 1:10, or 2 hours 45 minutes before departure in normal traffic. A Southwest nonstop at 5:20 p.m., arriving ATL at 7:45 p.m., gives roughly 90 minutes more cushion. There is also a Delta nonstop at 7:05 p.m., arriving ATL at 9:34 p.m.
Is the 3:55 Delta still the same price we had, and are any of those returns changeable?

The 3:55 p.m. Delta is now $247 one way in Main Cabin, up $61 from the earlier quote. It is changeable without a change fee, though a fare difference would apply. The 7:05 p.m. Delta is $229 in Main Cabin under the same terms. Southwest’s 5:20 p.m. Wanna Get Away Plus fare is $198 and can be changed without a fee, with any fare difference applying; if canceled, it provides a transferable flight credit rather than a cash refund.
I do not want to plan around leaving the museum at exactly noon. What happens if the inspection discussion goes until 12:45?

If you leave at 1:00 p.m., normal Thursday traffic would put you at MSY around 1:30 to 1:55. That leaves only about two hours before the 3:55 Delta departure, and less if there is a crash, heavy traffic, or a delay retrieving bags from the hotel. The 5:20 Southwest would leave about 3 hours 25 minutes at the airport even with the slower estimate. The 7:05 Delta has the most margin but gets you home nearly two hours later than Southwest.
Could I leave my luggage at the Cambria and pick it up after the inspection without making the earlier flight unrealistic?

You could, but it adds backtracking. The Cambria is near the museum, so luggage pickup would probably add 10 to 20 minutes if the bag is ready at the desk. With a 12:45 finish, you might reach MSY around 1:45 to 2:10. The 3:55 Delta would still be possible, but I would not call that a dependable plan with a checked case. The later flights remain comfortable.

Then for this trip, take Southwest on Thursday even though Delta was my first choice. The extra margin matters more than the airline, and I would rather not wait until 7:05. Keep the Sunday Delta if that timing is still sound.

That combination is practical: Delta outbound Sunday at 5:35 p.m., arriving 6:10 p.m., and Southwest home Thursday at 5:20 p.m., arriving Atlanta at 7:45 p.m. The outbound leaves ample time to reach the hotel before Monday morning, and the return allows the inspection to run about 45 minutes late, followed by luggage pickup and normal travel to MSY, without forcing a rushed airport arrival.
Before booking, give me the total and confirm there is no connection on either flight. One checked exhibition case outbound and back, plus my carry-on.

Both flights are nonstop. Delta Main Cabin on Sunday is $184, and the first checked case is $35. Southwest Wanna Get Away Plus on Thursday is $198 and includes two checked bags, so there is no charge for the case on that leg. The combined airfare and known bag fee total $417. Your carry-on is included on both flights. Seats are assigned on Delta; Southwest currently uses open seating for this flight.
Book those two flights. Use the case as my checked bag, and make sure the Thursday booking is for January 15, not Wednesday.

The flights are booked for the confirmed four-night trip.

Sunday, January 11: Delta flight DL 2147, nonstop from ATL at 5:35 p.m. to MSY at 6:10 p.m., Main Cabin. The fare is $184, with one checked exhibition case added for $35. Delta confirmation: G7K4QP.

Thursday, January 15: Southwest flight WN 1862, nonstop from MSY at 5:20 p.m. to ATL at 7:45 p.m., Wanna Get Away Plus. The $198 fare includes the checked case. Southwest confirmation: 4J9LTX.

Total airfare and bag charges are $417. The Thursday date is January 15. Plan to leave the museum by about 1:15 p.m. after retrieving the case from the Cambria; even with a 40-minute drive, that should put you at MSY more than three hours before departure. The Cambria room has not yet been booked.
